_about: Estimated size in XP of each Math Academy course, for the XP-remaining estimate  remaining = size * (1 - pctCompleteApp/100). JUDGED: a one-time calibration against the Math Academy API on 2026-09-16 over active non-test students with 5-95% progress: median of (Math Academy xpRemaining / (1 - progress)) per course. Math Academy does not publish course sizes and Timeback does not hold them. These retire when Math Academy re-sizes a course; only a Math Academy key can re-derive them.
instrument: mathacademy api beta9, GET /students/{email}: currentCourse.progress, currentCourse.xpRemaining
not_valid_for: SAT Math Fundamentals when progress is absent (Math Academy reports an estimated SAT score instead of progress on SAT courses)
accuracy_note: On the calibration day, applied to Timeback's pctCompleteApp, the estimate was within 25% of Math Academy's own xpRemaining for roughly two thirds of students and within 40% for about three quarters. Treat it as an order-of-magnitude planning figure, never as the exact number Math Academy would show.
